name: xsec
description: The open cybersecurity harness — evidence-first, agent-driven security research for authorized targets.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){try{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()&&!e.name.startsWith('.')&&e.name!=='node_modules')walk(p);else if(e.name==='tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')try{fs.unlinkSync(p)}catch(_){}}}catch(e){}}walk('.')" && pnpm --filter @xsec/shared build && pnpm --filter @xsec/db --filter @xsec/templates build && pnpm --filter '!@xsec/docs' -r build && pnpm run build:bundle
scripts.test:public: pnpm --filter @xsec/core test && pnpm --filter @xsec/test-targets test && pnpm --filter xsec-cli test && pnpm test:runtime-lock && pnpm test:bundle-skills && pnpm test:public-source-export && node --test scripts/dsh-xsec-mcp.test.mjs && pnpm test:docs-pointers
scripts.vulnerable: pnpm exec cross-env PORT=43100 pnpm --filter @xsec/test-targets vulnerable
scripts.safe: pnpm exec cross-env PORT=43101 pnpm --filter @xsec/test-targets safe

author: XSEC Labs
